program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = 9.8; const t = time; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const height = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const scaleY = 40; const baseY = 320; const ballY = baseY - height * scaleY; const lane = sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: 'Vertical Toss', state: 'Time: ' + sdk.format(t, 2) + ' s' }); const axis = sdk.axis('axis.height', { x: 80, y: 320, length: 260, orientation: 'y', min: 0, max: 2.5, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5], label: 'Height', unit: 'm' }); const guide = sdk.groundMark('guide.launch', 160, 320, 60, 'Launch'); const ball = sdk.circle('ball.toss', 160, ballY, 28, { role: 'output' }); const vVal = velocity; const aVal = -gravity; const vecV = sdk.vector('vec.v', { x: 160, y: ballY }, { value: Math.abs(vVal), direction: vVal >= 0 ? 'up' : 'down' }, { scale: 10, minLength: 12, label: 'v' }); const vecA = sdk.vector('vec.a', { x: 190, y: ballY }, { value: Math.abs(aVal), direction: 'down' }, { scale: 10, minLength: 12, label: 'a' }); let motionText = 'Moving up'; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionText = 'Still for an instant'; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionText = 'Moving down'; } const callout = sdk.callout(220, ballY - 20, [motionText, 'Gravity pulls down']); const objects = [lane, axis, guide, ball, vecV, vecA, callout]; let motionStateVal = 0; if (Math.abs(velocity) >= 0.05) { motionStateVal = velocity > 0 ? 1 : 2; } const motionStateStr = motionStateVal === 1 ? 'Moving up' : (motionStateVal === 2 ? 'Moving down' : 'Still for an instant'); const gravityStateStr = 'Gravity pulls down'; return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: 'motionState', value: motionStateStr }, { id: 'gravityState', value: gravityStateStr }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls downward.
manifest.description: A simulation of a tossed ball showing its vertical motion, velocity vector, constant downward gravity vector, and descriptive callout on a height scale.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
